The retained J supplies two. One additional scalar one-return macro with phase-even wrappers raises capacity by at most one, regardless of its Clifford rank. Two rank-one top-ups consume the entire 192 raw saving across 96 Type A ports before setup and routing.

The separate erased-carrier check grants arbitrary linear maps preserving common phase/body fibres. A same-volume canonical rank-one or rank-two top-up fails the exact width-eight displacement gate. Rank two requires at least 96/77 of the field volume. Charging that volume makes the full margin at the incumbent crossing less than −46.77 raw even with ancillary work free. The proof states the rank-three and higher price bound and leaves enlarged rank-one packing and a redesigned helper that preserves its independent productive return open.
